title: Technology Sector Update for 10/08/2018: ARNC, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG, JELD, SKYS - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.02%
AAPL: -0.12%
IBM: -0.48%
CSCO: -Flat
GOOG: -0.33%
Technology stocks were mostly lower pre-bell Monday.
Early movers include:
(+) Arconic ( ARNC ), which was trading more than 3% higher after reports that it has attracted interest from a large private equity consortium, with sources saying Arconic will decide later this month if it will pursue a sale.
Other sector news:
(=) JELD-WEN Holding ( JELD ) received a favorable ruling in a trade secrets litigation against Steves & Sons.
(=) Sky Solar Holdings ( SKYS ) failed to meet its price criteria for continued listing because the average closing price of the company's American Depositary Shares ( ADS ) was less than $1.00 per ADS over a consecutive 30-trading-day period.
